== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Susannah Dy]].
* '''Portion used:''' the whole image at the size the site serves.
* '''Replaceability:''' no free photograph of her is known.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use.
* '''Copyright:''' the photographer or MTN Haus. Used under fair use for identification only.
